name: MMIdleAlpha
short: Discord alpha code redeem bridge for MMIdle
description: Lets players redeem MMIdle alpha codes directly from Discord and provides admin configuration commands for the redeem API bridge.
end_user_data_statement: This cog sends the invoking Discord user ID and redeem code to your configured MMIdle API endpoint. It stores API configuration and secrets in Red Config.
